input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0088.png')
# Let's inspect the vase bottom
mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 150) & (img[:, :, 2] < 50)
ys, xs = np.where(mask)
print('Vase bottom v:', np.max(ys), 'u at bottom:', np.mean(xs[ys == np.max(ys)]))

# Sofa bottom
# Sofa is grey: R ~ 100-140, G ~ 100-140, B ~ 120-160
mask_sofa = (img[:, :, 0] > 110) & (img[:, :, 0] < 150) & (img[:, :, 1] > 100) & (img[:, :, 1] < 140) & (img[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 140)
ys_s, xs_s = np.where(mask_sofa)
if len(ys_s) > 0:
    print('Sofa bottom v:', np.max(ys_s), 'u range:', np.min(xs_s), np.max(xs_s))
"
